## Procedures to evaluate simulated data
### Simulated data generated by ART
1. Run ART and select the reads from sequences with valid taxonomy information. This generate 1 million paired-end data
```
/art_illumina -ss HS25 -i ./pv_cat.fna -p -l 100 -f 0.003 -m 1000 -s 100 -o art_p_f003_
awk 'NR%4==1' art_p_f003_1.fq | shuf --random-source art_p_f003_1.fq > art_p_f003.header

perl ExtractValidArtSimReads.pl art_p_f003_1.fq p_seqid.map nodes.dmp 1000000 shuf_header.txt > pv_sim_1M_1.fq
perl ExtractValidArtSimReads.pl art_p_f003_2.fq p_seqid.map nodes.dmp 1000000 shuf_header.txt > pv_sim_1M_2.fq
```

2. Generate the truth data

```
perl GetArtTruthTable.pl p_sim_1M_1.fq p_seqid.map > sim_truth.out
```

3. Run classifiers

Centrifuger: centrifuger -t 8 -x cfr_pv -1 $r1 -2 $r2 > cfr_class.out

Kaiju: kaiju -t nodes.dmp -f kaiju_protein.fmi -i $1 -j $r2 -z 8 > kaiju_class.out

Kraken2: kraken2 --paired --db kraken_protein --threads 8 $r1 $r2 > kraken_class.out 

Then we shall select the three columns: read_id, taxonomy_id and score as the final output for the evaluation script, e.g. "cut -f1,3,4 cfr_class.out | grep -v readID > cfr_3c.out".

4. Run evaluation, using centrifuger's transformed output as the example.
```
python3 sim_evaluate.py --truth sim_truth.out --tree nodes.dmp -c cfr_3c.out
```

### CAMI2's simulated data
Generate CAMI2's truth table
```
zcat reads_mapping.tsv.gz | grep -v "^#" | awk 'NR%2==1' | cut -f1,3 | sed "s/\/1//g" > sim_truth.out
```

The running command and the evaluation procedure is the same as the evaluation for ART-generated simulated data.
